args.title: Tamarack Components – "Warehouse automation in 2026" (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter (Tamarack Components, "Warehouse automation in 2026"): weekly roundup on warehouse automation trends, linking to the full article and a companion case-study piece.
- Article (blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse): pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece (insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion): the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
